topic: Asymptotic Stress Fields and SIF Near Collinear Cracks in Elastic Solids

papers.title: Exact Potential Solutions for Collinear Cracks in Transversely Isotropic Solids
papers.abstract: Exact analytical solutions for collinear cracks in transversely isotropic elastic media using Fabrikant potentials to determine Mode I stress intensity factors K_I and COD fields.

papers.title: Asymptotic Analysis of Crack Interaction Under Remote Tension
papers.abstract: Boundary element analysis of crack interaction comparing with Kachanov method and analytical Westergaard solutions.
